findings.title: Recheck the cache after acquiring the write lock
findings.body: Multiple production requests can read a nil cache before the first request acquires the write lock. Each of those requests then unconditionally reopens and decodes assets-manifest.json, even after the first request has populated the cache. Because these loads now run under an exclusive lock, concurrent cache misses cause serialized manifest loads and unnecessary request delays. After acquiring the write lock, recheck entryPointAssetsCache and return it when non-nil and cfg.Env is not setting.Dev.
